answers.answer: We confirm that we will only communicate with the bank through the tender portal during the competition.
Met. The tender is written in English and will be submitted through the tender portal before the deadline of 22 January 2027 12:00 CET.
answers.note: The bid manager must plan the submission so it is in the portal before 22 Jan 2027 12:00 CET, and should aim for an earlier internal deadline. A person must submit and confirm receipt. The capability sheet has no evidence for this formal requirement.
answers.change_note: Replaced the wrong date (29 January) with the RFP deadline of 22 Jan 2027 12:00 CET, as the finding on K002 asked.
answers.original_answer: The tender will be submitted through the tender portal in English before 29 January 2027.

answers.answer: Met. Nordlys holds an ISO/IEC 27001 certification covering development, hosting and operation of all Nordlys Accounts & Data services, valid until September 2028.
Met. Our references for Accounts & Data are a Swedish savings bank (live 2023) and a Danish regional bank (live 2025). Both have agreed to act as references, and both are within the five-year period.
answers.note: No Norwegian reference is available, so none is claimed. The bid team should collect the reference contact details for the submission.
answers.change_note: Removed the unsupported Norwegian reference and kept only the Swedish and Danish banks, as the finding on K009 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. Our references include a Norwegian savings bank, a Swedish savings bank and a Danish regional bank.

answers.answer: Met. The solution supports current accounts, savings accounts and fixed-term deposits for retail and business customers.
Met. The interest and fee engine is configured with rules set by the bank, including tiered and date-dependent rates.
Met. Account events are published to an event streaming platform that other systems can subscribe to.
answers.note: CAP-21 fully supports the answer. A product specialist may confirm during review which event types are published.
answers.change_note: Replaced the 'nightly files' answer with the event streaming capability from CAP-21, as the finding on K020 asked.
answers.original_answer: Partly met. Account data can be delivered to other systems as nightly files.

answers.answer: Met. Our parallel-run toolkit reconciles balances between the current core system and Nordlys automatically every day.
Met. All services are available as REST APIs with OpenAPI 3 specifications.
Met. Access-to-account and payment initiation APIs follow the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 standard and include consent management.
Met. API calls are logged with time, caller and consent reference. The retention period is configurable up to 10 years, which covers the required five years.
answers.note: CAP-34 does not say explicitly that every API call is logged. A product specialist should confirm this wording and that the five-year retention is set in the contract.
answers.change_note: Filled the empty answer from CAP-34, including the five-year retention, as the finding on K027 asked.

answers.answer: Met. A documented common data model for customers, accounts, products and transactions is delivered to the bank.
Met. Data quality dashboards measure completeness, accuracy and timeliness for each data product.
Partly met. Data lineage is provided from the source systems into the data platform. Lineage from the data platform into the bank's own reporting tools is not included.
answers.change_note: Changed 'Met' to 'Partly met' and stated that the last step into the bank's reporting tools is not covered, as the finding on K032 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. The solution keeps full data lineage from every source system to the bank's reports.

answers.answer: Met. Each AI function comes with a documentation package describing purpose, data used, explanation method and human review points.

Met. The data quality assistant (in production) only suggests corrections that a person approves. The adviser insight summary is a pilot, with general availability planned for 2027, and makes no automated decisions.

Partly met. Hosting and backups are in data centres in Norway and Finland. Third-line technical support uses a follow-the-sun model that includes an engineering team outside the EU/EEA. Support access can be limited to EU/EEA staff only as a paid option.
answers.note: A commercial owner must decide whether to offer the paid EU/EEA-only support option in the bid, and the price section must include its cost.
answers.change_note: Removed the claim that support access stays in the EU/EEA and disclosed the non-EU/EEA third-line support and the paid option, as the finding on K043 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. All customer data, backups and support access stay within the EU/EEA, with hosting in Norway and Finland.

answers.answer: Met. Serious incidents are notified to customers within two hours of detection, which is inside the required four hours.
answers.change_note: Corrected 24 hours to two hours per CAP-74, as the finding on K046 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. Serious ICT incidents are reported to the bank within 24 hours of detection.

answers.answer: Met. Nordlys takes part in customers' resilience testing, including TLPT.
Met. A standard exit plan and exit assistance are described in the service agreement.
Partly met. The standard SLA gives 99.9 % availability per month. The required 99.95 % is available only with the Premium SLA, which carries an extra cost.
answers.note: A commercial owner must decide whether to offer the Premium SLA and ensure the price section includes its cost. The answer can then be changed to 'Met' with Premium SLA.
answers.change_note: Corrected the claim that the standard SLA gives 99.95 % and disclosed the Premium SLA and its extra cost, as the finding on K050 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. Our standard SLA guarantees 99.95 % availability per month.

answers.answer: Partly met. The standard maintenance window is 00:00–04:00, announced 14 days in advance. The 14-day notice matches the requirement, but the window differs from the required 01:00–05:00.
answers.note: An operations specialist must confirm whether the window can be moved to 01:00–05:00 for this customer. If so, the answer can be changed to 'Met'.
answers.change_note: Replaced the unsupported 01:00–05:00 window with the actual 00:00–04:00 window and set 'Partly met', as the finding on K051 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. Planned maintenance is done between 01:00 and 05:00 and announced 14 days in advance.

answers.answer: Partly met. We offer 24/7 support in English for critical incidents. Norwegian-speaking support is available on weekdays 08:00–16:00, not 24/7.
answers.note: A support or operations specialist must decide whether 24/7 Norwegian-language support for critical incidents can be arranged, and at what cost. The sheet documents no such capability.
answers.change_note: Changed 'Met' to 'Partly met' and described the English 24/7 and Norwegian weekday-only support, as the finding on K052 asked.
answers.original_answer: Met. We offer 24/7 support in English and Norwegian.

answers.answer: Met. The migration toolkit supports test migrations, automatic reconciliation and rollback for each migration step.
